scope: Official WSV-generated Kaub W historical export for the previously missing 2026-09-06 through 2026-09-18 UTC interval; source facts only.

series.timestamp_basis: ISO-8601 timestamps carry the legally valid German offset (MEZ/MESZ); archived rows use +02:00. Thus market start 2026-09-06T16:26:59Z is 18:26:59+02:00; first later sample is 18:30+02:00.

coverage: The ZIP timestamps cover 2026-09-06T00:00Z through 2026-09-18T23:45Z at 15-minute spacing, with no gaps in the post-start rows. Its local end date is Sep19 because +02:00 is applied. It overlaps the separate W API series from Sep18 01:15+02; this archive was independently summarized, not merged with that series.
limits: This proves only the values in this official export (whose metadata labels quality unchecked). It finds no 77cm reading in the covered pre-October interval. It does not determine the contract's date-window interpretation or later observations. No probability, verdict, or market prices included.
